note: Proposed thresholds, not yet validated with the service technician. ratio = damage area / vehicle area. A class is graded by the first band whose 'below' is above the ratio, otherwise by 'otherwise'. Classes without bands always get 'otherwise'.

lamp_broken.why: a broken lamp must be replaced before the vehicle is roadworthy

glass_shatter.why: shattered glass affects visibility and safety; the glass must be replaced

tire_flat.why: the vehicle is not safe to drive until the tyre is fixed
